## Hand-authored

Extraction-degradation edge cases live upstream recipes rarely exercise in one file; each is live-verified to degrade gracefully (RAW_MALFORMED/NAME_ONLY/UNION_MARKED) or parse outright -- never raise:

- `unicode_name/recipe.yaml` -- non-ASCII/emoji component names and identifiers, plus two unresolved `${{ ... }}` function-call forms.
- `oversized_deps/recipe.yaml` -- a ~1,500-entry `run:` dependency list (well under the 5MB/8KB-per-line NFR-S5 caps).
- `exotic_jinja_loop/meta.yaml` -- nested `{% if %}`/`{% for %}` tags combined with `# [cond]` selector comments.
